result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but there are inconsistencies in the 'Popular right now' cards: a favorite (heart) button rendered with a dark filled background instead of the standard white circle, an implausible '-100%' discount badge, and a thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel with a washed-out background inconsistent with its siblings.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is rendered as a dark filled circle with a dark outline icon, unlike the white circular button with dark icon used on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card. The icon nearly disappears against its own background, making it hard to see and tap confidently.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white (or translucent light) circular background and dark heart icon to all favorite buttons so the control is consistent and legible over any image.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-100%', implying the item is entirely free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting error (e.g., a discount value mis-scaled).
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering; cap or format them correctly (e.g., '-50%' or 'Free item') and hide the badge for invalid/100% values unless genuinely intended.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a pale grey/white background while the neighbouring cards use dark, photographic backgrounds, breaking visual consistency across the row.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (same background tone or an overlay gradient) for all carousel thumbnails so badges and cards read uniformly.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice — once as an overlay badge on the image and again in the metadata line beneath the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in only one place, or suppress the metadata duplicate when the badge is present.
